text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT 5995012346 - GPU pool saturation and driver faults in eu-west-1

incident-bot: Autoscaler reports repeated scale denies; pool gpu-eu-west at configured max_nodes=90 and returning 429 throttles. Queue growth observed starting 2026-03-12T18:36:00Z. Multiple node-level driver errors (Xid/oom) detected. Pager engaged.

sara: ack, I'm taking lead. Noted customer errors on embeddings/chat. Paging infra + runtime.

omar: looking at cluster. Scheduler can't place new pods due to eviction churn. Head and control plane healthy but worker node readiness flapping.

kevin: runtime logs show bursts of `Xid 13` then `oom-kernel` on several hosts: eu-gpu-03, eu-gpu-07, eu-gpu-12. These all upgraded to driver 526.10 in yesterday's rollout.

jamie: which workloads spiked? We have some pinned long experiments and a batch rerank job. Models with >4k context most active.

omar: traffic graph shows sharp backlog at 18:35->18:44 UTC, ~380 requests/min piling on. Autoscaler tried scale but `max_nodes` hit.

nina: notifying impacted customers now: list includes fintech partner Collider, 2 enterprise trial orgs. Sending initial incident notice.

alpha-deploy-bot: deploy: driver-rollback request created to revert to 521.77. Canary planned on eu-gpu-canary-1.

kevin: validated locally: reverting driver to 521.77 eliminates reproducible Xid for the failing model under stress. Recommend immediate canary.

omar: submitting quota increase request to cloud team to temporarily bump pool cap 90->110 while rollback completes. Ticket INF-1719 created.

sara: mitigation plan:
- bump pool cap to 110 if quota allows
- rollback driver to 521.77 via daemonset canary then bulk
- preempt non-critical, long-running experiments to free GPUs
- temporarily route low-priority traffic to us-east to relieve eu-west
- keep customers informed every 15m

kevin: canary started. Command:
```
kubectl -n ops set image daemonset/gpu-driver driver-img=redwood/driver:521.77
kubectl -n ops rollout status daemonset/gpu-driver --timeout=5m
```

omar: infra-ops confirmed quota bump to 110 and updated autoscaler config. New nodes provisioning. Watch for node image drift (driver mismatch on boot).

jamie: please drain and preempt `experiment=research` labeled pods. Those are the biggest consumers.

omar: preempt policy applied; evicted 6 experiments, releasing 18 GPUs. Queue immediate drop starting +4m.

kevin: rollback continuing. Eviction events declining, driver faults on eu-gpu-12 stopped after revert. Error rate on /v1/embeddings down ~55% from peak. Latency tails improving.

nina: support updated customers: impact window initial 18:34-19:10 UTC. CS managers escalated for any SLA concerns.

alpha-deploy-bot: rollback-complete: driver image rolled back to 521.77 across pool.

sara: monitoring the last-mile. Tasks before closing pager:
1) confirm no Xid/OOMs for 30m across pool
2) scale pool back to nominal max_nodes=90 once stable
3) incident write-up + action items (canary + mem-stress tests pre-rollout)
4) follow-up with cloud for faster quota escalation path

kevin: starting regression sweeps against failing workload now. No Xid reproduction in initial 20m. Gathering logs into ticket TCK-2026.

omar: scaled down extra nodes, pool at 90 by 19:20 UTC. Autoscaler healthy.

sara: handing off monitoring & postmortem to kevin and infra-ops. I'll update runbook with lessons.

nina: customers confirmed service recovering; one asked for RCA timeline. We'll provide a tentative postmortem in 48h.

kevin: action items assigned: (a) add kernel/driver mem-fragment stress to driver canary suite; (b) expand autoscaler early-warning to surface driver fault patterns; (c) document faster rollback path.

sara: good work. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager resolved for thread 5995012346 (closed).
